- Pose off along the camera ray (a z-only sweep cannot see this): the median depth residual between the mesh and the observed surface is -0.08 to +0.35 cm.

1) How the scorer charges it. It is true that AUC.py anchors translation on slot 0 at frame 0 (_align_registered_scene). That would matter only for a pose bias, and depth rules a pose bias out. The cost of a short mesh comes from _register_object_body. It rescales our mesh by the RMS-radius ratio, aligns it by trimmed ICP from PCA starts, and so maps the hidden GT anchor onto the wrong point of our mesh.
2) How much, and in which frames. I ran a counterfactual through AUC.py's own steps (register, convert, align, symmetric ADD, AUC) with the official seed 10000131.
